entry.title: Four Dynasties — The Machine Behind the School
entry.content:
Four interlocking dynasties converge on one charter school enterprise. Each contributed a structural component that makes the machine run:

What Each Dynasty Contributed

DynastyStructural RoleFederal RecordWhat They Gave Banks
Banks/Flenory (BMF)Blood lineageOD Banks: BMF Defendant #22. Tonesa Welch: BMF defendantThe family brand. The extraction playbook. The zero-accountability narrative.
StallworthSocial incubationKeith: $20K gang money laundering (2003)BCF board access → family donations → MacDowell Board President → DPSCD authorization pipeline
SabreeJudicial captureFBI-probed 2019, Bowles class action2 children on the bench covering the enterprise’s courts. Foreclosure pipeline.
KilpatrickPolitical infrastructureKwame: 24 federal RICO feloniesPR machine (Dumas), dark money (Daniels → Detroit Leaders), charter authorization (Gay-Dagnogo), and the brand association (Carolyn at CBC party)

The Structuring Pattern — Two Decades, One Crime

WhoWhenAmountFor WhomMethodSentence
Keith Stallworth1998 (pled 2003)$20,000“A gang”False CTR at Michigan National Bank — hid true ownerPlea deal (conspiracy charges dropped)
Kenneth Daniels2010 (convicted 2014)$19,000Drug kingpin Carlos PowellTwo cashier’s checks at two banks — evaded $10K reporting1 year
Brian Banks2003–2016MultipleHimselfCheck fraud, forgery, financial transaction device, false pretenses≤8 months + 1 day total

Three men. Three structuring schemes. Three barely-there sentences. All three remained active in Detroit politics. All three connected to the same network.

The Powell drug operation that Daniels served: $21 million laundered, 12 kg cocaine, 30 kg heroin, 1,000 lbs marijuana. Both Powell brothers got life. Daniels got one year. Keith Stallworth’s conspiracy charges were dropped. Banks has served less than nine months total across 9 convictions.

The Racial Solidarity Shield

All four dynasties used the same armor: racial solidarity.

The Stallworths ran the Black Caucus Foundation. The Sabrees built a judicial dynasty in the most Black city in America. The Kilpatricks embodied Black political power in Detroit. Banks frames himself as a “redemption story” for a Black community that believes in second chances.

The armor works because it exploits something real. The history of racism against Black Detroiters is not fabricated. The distrust of institutions that have failed Black communities is earned. The desire for Black leadership in Black institutions is legitimate.

But when that legitimate desire is weaponized to protect a man who produces 3% math proficiency — when 97% of overwhelmingly Black children cannot do grade-level math while $4.9 million flows through shell entities — the armor is not protecting the community. It is trapping them inside the machine.

The crack trade destroyed these neighborhoods. The foreclosure pipeline stripped them of wealth. Kwame’s corruption bankrupted their city. And now the children who grew up in that wreckage sit in classrooms run by the same families, at the same addresses, with the same zero-accountability playbook — and they can’t do math.

The machine survived every prosecution. It survived the crack era, the RICO case, the FBI probes, the money laundering pleas. It put on a suit. It moved into the school system. It counts heads for per-pupil funding.

The Convergence Points

Where all four dynasties physically intersected:

Wayne County CourthouseJudges Sabree, Sabree, Yancey, Perkins, MillerJudicial capture — enterprise cases land before network judges

Michigan LegislatureBanks, Gay-Dagnogo, Keith Stallworth, Thomas Stallworth III, Kenneth Daniels, Bert JohnsonWhere the political relationships were forged

The Intermediaries — Where the Dynasties Meet the Schools

The dynasties provide the infrastructure. But someone has to physically connect the political power to the school operation. These intermediaries are the new family blood — not dynasty heirs, but operators who embedded themselves across multiple institutions in sequence, creating the handoff chains.

Wife’s purchasesWife Badriyyah bought Harper Woods homes at a 2011 tax auction while Sabree was deputy treasurer coordinating the sale
